# How much TFSA room do you have, and what would an excess cost?

> Free TFSA room and over-contribution checker for Canadians: work out your contribution room from 2009, see whether a planned deposit puts you over, and what the CRA's 1% per month tax would cost. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
